description: We are a creative and passionate team interested in storytelling, science, space exploration, and digital creativity. We enjoy turning scientific ideas into engaging stories that are educational, imaginative, and easy to understand. We are looking for team members who are creative, responsible, and passionate about writing, illustration, research, and digital storytelling. Together, we hope to create a meaningful story that inspires others to explore and learn.
summary:
INNOVA TECH G SMART presents "Abandoned but not Forgotten," a storytelling project inspired by NASA's space exploration missions.
Our project uses a short video to introduce audiences to the equipment NASA has left on the Moon and Mars. Through storytelling and visual presentation, we explore the purpose of these objects, their missions, and the scientific contributions they made.
Our main objective is to make space exploration history more interesting, understandable, and accessible, especially for younger audiences.
We believe every piece of equipment has a story worth remembering, because even after a mission ends, its discoveries continue to inspire future generations.
details:
Our project is a short-form educational storytelling video designed to introduce NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The project focuses on presenting space exploration history in a simple and engaging format. We aim to explain what the equipment was, why NASA sent it into space, what scientific purpose it served, and why it remains on the Moon or Mars.

Our approach combines educational information with visual storytelling to make the subject easier for school-age audiences to understand.

The project was developed through teamwork, idea-sharing, content preparation, and video production.
